title: Blocks Pro
description: The Blocks Pro texture pack gives Minecraft a completely new, professional look. The tools have been thoroughly redesigned: swords, axes, shovels, pickaxes, and hoes now feature sharper lines, stronger colors, and a unified design that immediately stands o
body:
BlocksPro is a modern and performance-friendly texture pack that visually enhances many blocks and tools. The goal of this pack is to give Minecraft a cleaner, sharper, and more detailed look while staying true to the original Minecraft style.

Several blocks have been re-rendered to feature improved textures, better contrast, and a more modern design. Tools have also been redesigned to look more polished and consistent with the overall visual style.
